title: design.json
description: Describes one product's design repo: its name, its slug on the hub, the viewports frames are shown at, and the order of its flows. schemaVersion 1.

$schema.description: Optional path or URL of this schema, for editors.

name.description: Product name shown on the hub and the board.

slug.description: Lowercase kebab-case path of the product on the hub. Never changes once set.

viewports.description: Viewports every screen is shown at, in board order.

id.description: Lowercase kebab-case viewport id, used by design:viewports and in frame references.

flows.description: Flows in board order. Every folder under screens/ (except _shared) must be listed.

id.description: Lowercase kebab-case flow id; the folder name under screens/.

title.description: Flow title shown on the board.
